name: @blume/bridge-cluster
description: The k-of-n operator cluster behind bridge.blumefi.com: a HotPocket contract that watches the XRP Ledger and XRPL EVM and signs for both. Runs on Evernode.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist dist-app && ncc build src/loader.ts -o dist --minify=false && ncc build src/contract.ts -o dist-app --minify=false && cp dist-app/index.js dist/app.js && rm -rf dist-app && cp hp/hp.cfg.override dist/ && tsx scripts/bundle-genesis.ts
scripts.build:client: rm -rf dist-client && ncc build clients/stage1.ts -o dist-client --minify=false && ncc build clients/query.ts -o dist-client/query --minify=false
